summary: Neostellar Capital Corp., a Maryland business development company trading on Nasdaq, filed a Form 8-K furnishing preliminary third-quarter 2026 results and portfolio updates. Estimated net asset value as of September 30, 2026 is $12.25-$12.75 per share, down from $13.44 at June 30, 2026. The portfolio holds 34 companies, 30 private and 4 public. Quarterly activity included a $0.1 million warrant exercise in Shogun Enterprises (Hearth) and exits from GrabAGun, Aventine Property Group, and CW Opportunity 2 LP. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine earnings and portfolio update, not a special situation.
